cohort: 52,218 women who delivered either a singleton or twin pregnancy at a tertiary London maternity unit between 1999 and 2015
finding: Women delivering twins vaginally were not at a significantly higher risk of sustaining obstetric anal sphincter injuries compared to those delivering singletons.
mod_finding: This study found that women delivering twins vaginally were not at a significantly higher risk of sustaining obstetric anal sphincter injuries compared to those delivering singletons.
